budgetV2.noCategories: No categories yet — add one from a transaction first.
budgetV2.uncategorisedNote: {{amount}} was not in any category you track.
budgetV2.overspendInline: You have options for covering this.
budgetV2.overspendBody: You planned {{planned}} and have spent {{spent}}, so this is {{amount}} over. Here is how you can cover it.
budgetV2.raiseTargetHint: Plans to spend more here for the rest of the period.
budgetV2.overdueBody: These are still owed and still reserved.
budgetV2.needsAttentionShort: Several payments in a row are unpaid — worth a look.
budgetV2.rescheduleBody: Choose a new due date for {{name}}.
budgetV2.addBillBody: A one-off bill, or one of your recurring expenses.
budgetV2.billRecurringNote: The recurring expense stays in charge of the amount and the schedule. It is marked paid automatically when it posts.
budgetV2.commitmentEmpty: Track rent, subscriptions and other bills so they are set aside before you spend.
budgetV2.refundReviewTitle_one: {{count}} money-in entry looks like a refund
budgetV2.refundReviewBody: We have taken these off your spending because they share a category. Tell us if that is wrong.
budgetV2.refundRejected: No longer treated as a refund
budgetV2.savingsEmpty: Set money aside for something specific — it stays in your account, just held back.
budgetV2.contributionPlanned: {{amount}} reserved this period — not yet confirmed
budgetV2.spaceTransferRequired: Move the money into the Space to confirm this
budgetV2.confirmIsNeutral: Confirming does not change what is safe to spend — the money was already held back.
budgetV2.fundSpaceNote: You will move the money yourself; the transfer is what confirms it.
budgetV2.attributedBody: A report: refunds counted against the period the expense was in, not the period they arrived.
budgetV2.lifetimeTitle: Your old lifetime budget needs a decision
budgetV2.lifetimeBody: A lifetime budget of {{amount}} tracked everything you had ever spent. The new plans work in periods, so we have kept yours untouched rather than turning it into a monthly figure it never was.
budgetV2.salaryTitle: Is {{amount}} what you earn, or what you want to spend?
budgetV2.salaryBody: It closely matches your recent monthly income. The old budget had no place to record earnings, so some people put their income here.
budgetV2.salaryIncomeNote: Choosing income records it as your expected earnings and leaves the spending target for you to set.
budgetV2.legacyLinkMoved: That budget now lives on your plan.
budgetV2.categoriesRequired: Pick at least one category — otherwise this would not track anything.
budgetV2.catchAllNote: This one catches everything your other categories do not, so it has no category list and cannot be removed.
